title: The door that permits some tools
goal: {{castAgentId}} at {{castBrand}} is given demo-some-tools: a read-only grant for reading access and portfolio data, not for {{castSensitive}}.
obstacle: Discovery lists every tool the door knows about, including ones this caller must not run. A list is not a permission.
control: The simulated gateway lists 18 tools and marks 7 permitted and 11 not permitted. Calling a not-permitted tool is refused with 403 before it reaches the backend. That refusal is the policy working, so the verdict is Blocked by policy and is never shown as a fault.
say: Eighteen tools are visible and seven are permitted. The other eleven are listed so you can see what the policy withholds. A refusal here is a result, not a failure.

steps.title: Discover the tools
steps.tell: Pick demo-some-tools and run discovery. The verdict says 7 permitted and 11 not permitted for the identity the gateway evaluated. The 11 are marked Not permitted in the list.
steps.say: Same client, same call, a different policy: seven of eighteen.
steps.why: The list shape (all tools, with marks) is the lab's simulation. Whether a real gateway filters the list or marks it is UNVERIFIED.

steps.title: Run a permitted tool
steps.tell: Run get_investment_balance. The verdict is Allowed.
steps.say: Inside the grant, the call goes through.
steps.why: The grant is a list of exact tools, not a category.

steps.title: Run a tool outside the grant
steps.tell: Run sensitive_payroll_details, which guards {{castSensitive}}. The verdict is Blocked by policy: the simulated gateway answered 403 before any backend was reached.
steps.say: The door refuses at the gateway. The backend never sees the call.
steps.why: Enforcement sits in front of the tool, so a client that ignores the Not permitted mark is still stopped.

steps.title: Read the next step
steps.tell: The verdict card suggests choosing a permitted tool or asking a policy admin to extend the grant.
steps.say: A refusal tells you what to do next, in plain words.
steps.why: Refusals are neutral, not red: the control worked.
